Putin Addresses New Capabilities in Space Exploration

#ufotwitter #Russia

Nuclear powered systems created back in the USSR have already been put into operation in space.
We continue to develop these technologies, and this gives us new capabilities in deep space exploration.

According to that terminology, nuclear propulsion could refer to systems powered by fission reactors or by hot and cold fusion reactors.

They can be used to power satellites, directed energy weapons, and beam weapons, as well as energy sources for conventional and unconventional aircraft; the possibilities are endless.

Addressing comes from his April 16, 2025, meeting on space activities at Bauman Moscow State Technical University

Do you know from which university the Russian scientist Ivan Filimonenko, who said that in the 1950s, while working on military programs, he created an electromagnetic (Lorentz force) disc-shaped vehicle, graduated? He graduated from the same university where Putin delivered his speech.
